Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed. Frontend: video-player + video-delete rendered with correct testids; browser-side Range fetch returns 206 with valid mp4 ftyp box; delete removes card; caption/title classes (text-base / text-xl) confirmed in source.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 856 lines; consider splitting into routers (video, files, social, admin) for maintainability (>700-line threshold).

_ranged_video_response loads the ENTIRE mp4 into memory (vertex_video.download returns full bytes) before slicing the Range chunk. For 10MB Veo outputs this is fine, but larger outputs will pressure memory. Consider streaming from Cloud Run with a passthrough Range request or GCS signed URL redirect.
The download endpoint has Cache-Control: private, max-age=3600 which is good for browser seeking, but if a video gets deleted the cached bytes may linger — acceptable since URL is per-job-id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Range fix on /api/video/{id}/download verified: 206 Partial Content with correct Content-Range/Accept-Ranges/Content-Length, and valid mp4 (ftyp box at bytes 4..8). Chromium headless in playwright FAILS to decode Veo mp4s (DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS — missing proprietary H.264/AAC codecs in headless build); this is NOT a real bug — verified by in-page fetch that Range bytes arrive correctly. Real Chrome (which the user runs) has the codecs. Social Studio caption/title size verified via class attributes since no existing plan for admin user; could optionally generate a plan via POST /api/social/plans to visually confirm.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (fixed): the /api/video/{id}/download proxy returned the full mp4 as a single 200 response without Accept-Ranges. Chromium's media pipeline could not seek to the moov atom (which Veo places at the END of the file, not the beginning), so <video> stalled at 0:00 with a black frame. FIX (server.py _ranged_video_response): when Range header is present, respond with 206 + Content-Range + Content-Length for the requested byte slice; always advertise Accept-Ranges: bytes. Verified: (a) Range: bytes=0-1023 -> 206 with Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/<total>, Content-Length: 1024, ftyp box present. (b) No Range -> 200 with Accept-Ranges: bytes, correct Content-Length. (c) Mid-file range (start=total/2, 512 bytes) -> 206 with correct slice. (d) Delete: own RUNNING job -> {ok:true} and removed from GET /api/video/jobs; other user's job -> 404; nonexistent -> 404.
